description: A context name that upper-cases to WHEN, POST_INSTALL, PRE_UNINSTALL or PKG_OP never replaces the runner's own value: the fire point and the lifecycle come from the Update request, so the runner owns these four variables.
departure: Today pfb_run_hooks() adds the lifecycle flags with $ctx += pfb_hook_lifecycle_ctx(), so a caller's POST_INSTALL or PRE_UNINSTALL wins; WHEN and PKG_OP are assigned over the caller's.
